about_the_game:
Some rescue princesses, others save the whole world. But here, you save the schnitzel!

In "Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel", your stomach is rumbling, and there's only one solution – find the ingredients and cook the world-famous schnitzel! But even in Schländ, the schnitzel-loving country, it won't be easy!

Embark on a quirky adventure filled with unexpected encounters, platforming challenges and a fun merging mechanic. Explore a world brimmed with secrets, strange characters, and even stranger problems. Dig, swing, and sprint your way through a lovingly designed environment, where surprises await around every corner.

Features:

  • Explore Schländ - a compact yet densely packed country, packed with meaningful exploration and adventure

  • Meet and help the locals - from clueless cats to other helpless creatures, everyone has a problem and they all are counting on you

  • Merge and create - combine items in creative ways to overcome obstacles and craft new ones

  • Use your tools - dig up treasures with your shovel, uncover hidden places with the grappling hook, or speed through Schländ with your running shoes
